runners_activation_phase_identity_check.name: runners_activation_phase_identity_check
runners_activation_phase_identity_check.value: ("runners"."activation_phase" IS NULL AND "runners"."activation_id" IS NULL AND "runners"."activation_lifecycle" IS NULL) OR ("runners"."activation_phase" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."activation_phase" IN ('prepared', 'finalized') AND "runners"."activation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."activation_lifecycle" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."activation_lifecycle" IN ('ordinary', 'restart'))

runners_activation_lifecycle_restart_che.name: runners_activation_lifecycle_restart_check
runners_activation_lifecycle_restart_che.value: ("runners"."activation_lifecycle" IS NULL AND "runners"."activation_restart_id" IS NULL) OR ("runners"."activation_lifecycle" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."activation_lifecycle" = 'ordinary' AND "runners"."activation_restart_id" IS NULL) OR ("runners"."activation_lifecycle" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."activation_lifecycle" = 'restart' AND "runners"."activation_restart_id" IS NOT NULL)

runners_activation_scope_check.name: runners_activation_scope_check
runners_activation_scope_check.value: ("runners"."activation_phase" IS NULL AND "runners"."activation_source_id" IS NULL AND "runners"."activation_target_id" IS NULL AND "runners"."activation_target_generation" IS NULL AND "runners"."activation_machine_fingerprint" IS NULL AND "runners"."activation_platform" IS NULL AND "runners"."activation_architecture" IS NULL AND "runners"."activation_name" IS NULL) OR ("runners"."activation_phase" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."activation_source_id" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."activation_target_id" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."activation_target_generation" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."activation_target_generation" >= 0 AND "runners"."activation_machine_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."activation_platform" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."activation_architecture" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."activation_name" IS NOT NULL)

runners_activation_reservation_check.name: runners_activation_reservation_check
runners_activation_reservation_check.value: ("runners"."activation_reservation_id" IS NULL AND "runners"."activation_reservation_generation" IS NULL AND "runners"."activation_reservation_source_id" IS NULL) OR ("runners"."activation_reservation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."activation_reservation_generation" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."activation_reservation_generation" >= 0 AND "runners"."activation_reservation_source_id" IS NOT NULL)
